known_facts_book1: An immense Giantess living alone in the purple stone Yoop Castle, in a cup-shaped valley of the Gillikin Country.
Is the wife of Mr. Yoop, the giant who was captured and caged by the little folks for taking their cows and sheep; she escaped by transforming herself into a mouse and hiding in a cupboard.
Says she is glad her husband is gone, because he often kicked her on the shins when she would not wait on him.
Is **not exactly a Witch** but an Artist in Transformations — a **yookoohoo** — and claims the Yookoohoos are the cleverest magic-workers in the world.
Wears silver robes embroidered with floral designs and, over them, a short **lace apron** which is the only thing in the castle that can open its doors and windows.
Makes her food by transformation: biscuits from field-mice, honey from a wasp's nest, oatmeal from weeds, fish-balls from pebbles, coffee from water.
Cannot undo any transformation she makes — 'nothing I transform ever gets back to its former shape again' — which she cites as proof that even a clever Yookoohoo's powers are limited.
Had caught Polychrome asleep weeks earlier and caged her as a Canary-Bird, and complains the bird has been no company at all.

Transforms the Tin Woodman into a Tin Owl (forgetting to wish him meat), the Scarecrow into a straw-stuffed Brown Bear, and Woot into a Green Monkey — and adds magic to make each contented with the new form.
Says she never has friends, because friends get too familiar and always forget to mind their own business.
Snaps her fingers at the mention of Ozma, saying she cares nothing for a girl she has never seen.
Is locked in her own bedroom when Woot steals the Apron, but escapes by other magic and is later seen weaving a **new lace apron** to replace the lost one.
Is given the form of Woot the Wanderer by Ozma at a distance, smashes her mirror in rage on seeing it, and is then exchanged into the **Green Monkey** she herself created.
In that form she can perform no magical arts whatsoever, and will always remain a Green Monkey.

known_relations_book1.Woot: The boy she makes a Green Monkey and whose form she is finally given in exchange.
known_relations_book1.Polychrome: The Rainbow's Daughter she caged as a Canary.
known_relations_book1.Tin Woodman: Whom she makes a Tin Owl.
known_relations_book1.Scarecrow: Whom she makes a Brown Bear.
known_relations_book1.Ozma: The Ruler she scorns and who punishes her at a distance.
known_relations_book1.Mr. Yoop: Her caged giant husband, whom she is glad to be rid of.
